systems.country_label: property-tax reform pilot covering property identification and valuation
systems.owner: Addis Ababa City Government Revenues Bureau
systems.tiers: Addis Ababa; began July 2026; transition from land-rent and building-tax arrangement to value-based property tax

note: The Addis Ababa Revenues Bureau asked missions for lease and employee records, but the document states no revenue system or payer register; the pilot covers identification and valuation, a survey.
